findings.title: Fiadhrach is called elven despite the explicit absence of elves

sources.quote: Der Clan der Fiadhrach war ein elbisches Adelshaus des alten Fürstentums Glaennath.
Keine elfenohren elfen gibts bei uns nicht!

findings.explanation: The active house page introduces an elven identity that the user explicitly excluded. Glaennath/Alben as cultural names do not require an elven species. This is active page prose, not an ignored genealogy table.
findings.suggestedDirection: Describe the house as a Glaennath clan or an albisches Adelshaus; preserve its actual history and culture. No change made.

consistentCrossChecks.result: Current exile event, split businesses and Finlay's relationship with Klingende Münze are consistent.

limitations: Only current public file-based content was used; private dossiers and live authored biographies were excluded.
Narrative alternatives, historical relocations, and missing details are not automatically contradictions.
No genealogical chronology audit or military-statistics comparison was performed.
